title: artifact-verification
description: Machine-written proof that the verification step ran for a stage. Presence gate input: proves the step ran, not who ran it — actor is attribution, never authorization. Written to plans/<active-plan>/artifacts/verification.json.

stage.description: Stage this verification covers (push|pr|merge|ship|deploy); descriptive only, not enum-validated

plan.description: Plan dir name this verification belongs to

phase.description: Optional: the plan-graph node id (e.g. P3) this verification covers. Additive/optional (back-compat: an old verification omitting it still passes the gate). Enables the per-phase evidence snapshot (verification-<phase>.json) that derive_plan_completion counts for safe auto-close; a verification missing phase is simply not snapshotted (under-count, never over-close).

name.description: check name; for a DoD test type this is the test_type id (unit|integration|regression|coverage|security|lint|typecheck|...), or `<type>/<name>` to keep the tool's own name (lint/ruff, unit/full-suite)

status.description: PASS/SKIP clear the gate. FAIL = measured and wrong. BLOCKED = could not be measured at all (missing tool, no network, not yet owned) — it blocks exactly like FAIL, and exists so a report can count holes apart from defects.

format.description: result format the DoD gate re-reads this check's raw file with; optional (only on test-type checks). A check carrying `format` is DoD-bearing: its `name` MUST be a canonical test_type id (harness/data/test-policy.yaml) or `<type>/<name>` with such a type (`lint/ruff`), or the DoD gate reads it as a MISSING type. `manual` carries telemetry-anchored evidence instead of a result file (see evidence_tier/anchor_id/charter_cosign)

file.description: result file path relative to the plan's artifacts/ dir; the DoD gate re-derives pass/fail from THIS raw file, not from status. Must resolve under artifacts/ (no symlink escape)

evidence_tier.description: manual check only: `anchored` cites a Bash trace the manual-test hook witnessed (a floor, not authentication); `claimed` is agent-written and below the floor

anchor_id.description: manual check only: the cited anchor id (sha256/16) the DoD gate cross-checks against the manual-test anchor telemetry; a fabricated id is rejected. `trace_id` is accepted as an alias

trace_id.description: manual check only: alias for anchor_id

cmd.description: manual check only: the exact command that was run — carried so a reviewer on another machine can re-run it and so manual_test.verify_portable (transport-integrity, not a gate input) can recompute cmd_hash

cmd_hash.description: manual check only: sha256(cmd)[:16]; for a human to recompute portability, NOT a tier signal

output_hash.description: manual check only: sha256(real captured output)[:16]; a reviewer re-runs the real command and compares — transport-integrity only, grants no tier

charter_cosign.description: manual check only: a reviewer distinct from actor (personal-first: a distinct attribution string, not a roster check) who co-signed the charter; required for a HARD manual requirement — anchored output without a co-sign, or a self co-sign equal to actor, stays soft

checks.description: Named checks; any FAIL blocks hard stages. A check carrying format+file feeds the DoD-by-change-class gate, which re-reads the raw file (self-report does not self-approve)

verdict.description: Overall verdict of the verification run

change_class.description: Optional: the derived change-class (feature|bugfix|refactor|dep_bump_major|release) this run targeted; informational/telemetry — the gate re-derives from the git diff, it does not trust this field

signals.description: Optional: the fact-signals behind the derived change_class (src_changed, test_has_assertions, ...). Telemetry only; not a gate input

grace.description: Optional: a recorded policy grace honored for this run (carries reason + expires); written for audit visibility, never to lower the gate by itself

expires.description: ISO date; past it the gate stops honoring the grace and re-blocks hard

blastRadius.description: Optional/additive: reverse-deps + tests touched by a code change, filled by write_verification.py itself from hs_run_facts.engine (code.importers + code.tests_reached, default subjects) -- never hand-authored. Absent on a verification predating this field, or on a non-code change (docs/config-only) the writer never attempted to fill. On a code change, artifact_check.py's gate blocks a blastRadius that is present but empty or half-filled, or a marker with no reason; an absent key passes with a trace (every verification written before the field has none), and so does a key carrying unavailable/stale -- the codebase not having adopted code-graph snapshots, or the snapshot being stale, is not this change's fault.

reverseDeps.description: code.importers' own value shape: {changed file path: [direct importer path, ...]}

testsTouched.description: code.tests_reached's own value: test file paths reaching the change through the import graph, nearest first

basis.description: which facts filled this and on what subject scope

snapshot.description: the code-graph snapshot id the facts were read from

unavailable.description: true when the facts engine could not answer at all (no codemap.yaml adopted, or the engine crashed) -- see reason

stale.description: true when the code-graph snapshot backing these facts is missing or older than HEAD within its own roots -- see reason
